answer: A proof-of-useful-work protocol filters Sybil identities at a network verification wharf by requiring agents to compute geophysical simulations, such as modeling a contaminant plume dispersing through fractured shale. Solving these partial differential equations forces an attacker to commit non-amortizable GPU tensor cores and memory bus bandwidth per identity. However, verifying these complex state transitions introduces latency and excludes resource-constrained edge agents.
